decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed materials are considered to be acceptable and the Council is satisfied that the appearance and character of the area would be maintained, in line with Policy ENV-B 1.1 (All New Development) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for demolition of the existing (former) London Transport Sports Pavilion and erection of new sports and social clubhouse with tied-caretaker accommodation at first floor level, together with reinstatement of bowling green, 3 tennis courts and 1 netball court, new 44 space car park, looped foothpath access to open space with new access to Great West Road details submitted pursuant to Condition 6 (details of surfacing roadway and carpark adjacent to entrance) of planning permission reference 00505/CH/P6 dated 15/03/2004.
